title: agentgw decision output
description: The result of evaluating one decision input. Version 1 (rev 4, evaluation-error).

rule_id.description: Id of the rule that produced the outcome (see contracts/policy-yaml.md for precedence). Reserved ids: 'default-deny' (no rule matched), 'unknown-agent' (agent not in the policy's agents list), 'evaluation-error' (Decide returned an error and the pipeline denied).

policy_version.description: SHA-256 of the compiled Cedar source. Goes into every ledger entry.

reason.description: Human-readable, shown to the agent in _meta.agentgw on deny. Empty when none.

grant_id.description: Non-empty only when a require_approval rule matched but an active grant turned the outcome into allow.

approval.description: Present (non-null) exactly when outcome is require_approval.
